modifiers.message: You've grown so familiar with the swing of your tool that even with your feet off the ground, your strikes land cleanly. The air beneath you no longer hinders your swing. (+1 Airborne)
With countless strikes, you have mastered the balance of your tool. Your swings come faster now, with stone and earth giving way before you can even register the impact. (+1 Haste)
After breaking countless blocks, your tool has begun to hum with a quiet pull. Debris is drawn toward you now, rather than scattering to the ground. (+1 Magnetic)
You have meticulously maintained your tool, and your careful attention has paid off. As long as it stays in good repair, your mining will be swifter. (+1 Maintained)

You have learned the rhythm of your tool, each swing feeding into the next with greater ease. Every block you shatter quickens the next swing, building a cadence that grows faster the longer you keep mining. (+1 Momentum)
Through careful use and growing familiarity, you've learned to work with the grain of your tool rather than against it. It holds together longer now, and mends more easily. (+1 Preserved)
Long hours of use have tempered your tool beyond how it was forged. Its edge holds firmer now, less likely to wear with each strike you land. (+1 Reinforced)

Your weapon rings with a frequency that tears at the fabric of the void itself. Struck targets find themselves anchored in this world, unable to teleport for a brief time. (+1 Enderference)
Your weapon breathes heat from somewhere deep within its edge. Each strike ignites what it touches, setting your targets ablaze. (+1 Fiery)
Your weapon carries a bitter, creeping cold. Each strike chills what it touches, slowing your targets and sapping their health. (+1 Freezing)
Your weapon has developed a ravenous hunger, its edge sharpening with every hit. Each enemy struck feeds the blade... and makes it hungry for more. (+1 Insatiable)
You have learned to strike viciously and deliberately. The wounds you inflict leave your targets bleeding, hurting them even if they manage to escape your grasp. (+1 Lacerating)
Something dark and parasitic has seeped into your blade. Each critical wound you inflict siphons a sliver of stolen life into your veins. (+1 Necrotic)
With practice, you've grown precise enough with your weapon to strike through your targets' defenses. Your hits slip between the cracks, bypassing some of your enemies' armor. (+1 Pierce)
Through careful use and growing familiarity, you've learned to work with the grain of your weapon rather than against it. It holds together longer now, and mends more easily. (+1 Preserved)
Your weapon itself seems to mirror your desperation. The closer you are to death, the more savagely it strikes. (+1 Raging)
Long hours of use have tempered your weapon beyond how it was forged. Its edge holds firmer now, less likely to wear with each strike you land. (+1 Reinforced)
You have learned to deal your killing blows with surgical precision. Slain enemies are more likely to leave their heads behind. (+1 Severing)
Countless swings have honed your technique, and your weapon's edge along with it. It cuts deeper now, every hit landing harder. (+1 Sharpness)
Combat against the risen dead has anointed your weapon with a sense of holy purpose. It now strikes the undead with a newfound fury. (+1 Smite)
You've mastered your weapon's flourish. Your attacks sweep through groups of enemies in a single arc, punishing anything foolish enough to stand beside your target. (+1 Sweeping Edge)

Your bow has developed a ravenous hunger, its strikes sharpening with every hit. Each arrow that finds its mark feeds it... and makes it hungry for more. (+1 Insatiable)

You have meticulously maintained your bow, and your careful attention has paid off. As long as it stays in good repair, your arrows will fly swifter. (+1 Maintained)

You have learned the rhythm of your bow, each shot feeding into the next with greater ease. Every arrow you loose quickens the next draw, building a cadence that grows faster the longer you keep firing. (+1 Momentum)

Countless draws have honed your technique, and your bow's limbs along with it. Your arrows strike deeper now, every hit landing with greater force. (+1 Power)
Through careful use and growing familiarity, you've learned to work with the grain of your bow rather than against it. It holds together longer now, and mends more easily. (+1 Preserved)

You've walked through enough explosions to know how to brace for them. Your armor absorbs the shockwave better now, sparing you from the worst of the blast. (+1 Blast Protection)
Combat against the risen dead has anointed your armor with a sense of holy purpose. It now resists strikes from the undead with a newfound righteousness. (+1 Consecrated)
Your armor has been stressed and shaped by the forces it's endured, and come out tougher for it. It bends where it once would crack, increasing both its durability and toughness. (+1 Ductile)
Your armor radiates a searing heat that flares on impact. Strikes against you ignite the attacker, setting anyone who dares to cross you ablaze. (+1 Fiery)
Your armor radiates a bitter cold that erupts on impact. Strikes against you chill the attacker, slowing them and sapping their health. (+1 Freezing)
You've learned to channel the shock of incoming blows into a surge of force. Your attack damage is briefly boosted each time you take a hit. (+1 Kinetic)
You have meticulously maintained your armor, and your careful attention has paid off. As long as it stays in good repair, your armor will be more resilient against attack. (+1 Maintained)
You've learned to read a swing before it lands and shift your weight to meet it. Your armor catches blades better now, blunting the force of melee strikes. (+1 Melee Protection)
Through careful use and growing familiarity, you've learned to move in your armor rather than grinding it against itself. It holds together longer now, and mends more easily. (+1 Preserved)
You've grown attuned to the whistle of incoming fire and learned to angle away from it. Your armor catches arrows better now, turning direct hits into glancing blows. (+1 Projectile Protection)
Experience has taught you where to take a hit and how to roll with one you can't avoid. Your armor absorbs damage better now, reducing harm from all sources. (+1 Protection)

Your reflexes heighten and your resolve hardens in response to crisis. For a brief moment after taking a hit, your armor braces against the next blow, reducing the damage you take. (+1 Recurrent Protection)
Dent by dent, your armor has settled into something stronger than its original form. It resists wear more stubbornly now, less likely to take lasting damage from blows. (+1 Reinforced)
You've faced enough creatures born of fire to know how they burn. Your armor has been tempered by their particular heat, reducing the damage they deal. (+1 Scorch Protection)
The pattern of wear on your armor has left jagged edges and sharp ridges that punish contact. Anything that strikes you will regret the attempt. (+1 Thorns)
